# Decision Lab — Project Research
<!-- Generated by /kickoff on 2026-03-27 -->

## Vision
A new MiroShark page for simulation-guided decision making. Users define a situation (docs + URLs + text hypotheses), create 2-3 decision branches, run parallel simulations, and see consequence trees with causal chains, unintended consequences, and side-by-side comparison. Supports iterative "what-if" injection to re-run with new variables.

## Technology Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Alternatives | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-------------|-----------|
| Tree visualization | D3.js `d3.tree()` (hybrid Vue integration) | Vue Flow, Cytoscape.js, elkjs | Already in project (v7.9.0). Purpose-built for hierarchical trees. Zero new deps. Horizontal layout ideal for causal chains. |
| Vue + D3 pattern | Hybrid: D3 for layout math, Vue for SVG rendering | Full D3 imperative, Full Vue declarative | Best of both — Vue controls DOM, D3 does positioning. Encapsulate in `useConsequenceTree` composable. |
| Tree layout direction | Horizontal (left-to-right) | Vertical (top-to-bottom) | Temporal/causal reading is natural L→R. Better for wide monitors. Labels render cleanly without rotation. |
| Neo4j branching | Overlay node pattern (shared base graph) | Clone subgraph, APOC virtual nodes | Zero data duplication. Base graph is read-only during simulation. Branch metadata stored as `:DecisionBranch` node. |
| Process parallelism | Multiple subprocess.Popen (existing pattern) | Celery task queue, asyncio multiplexing | SimulationRunner already supports concurrent processes. Full isolation. Zero new deps. |
| Ollama concurrency | `OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4` | Serial, external queue | 3-4x throughput with 3 branches. ~40GB VRAM for qwen2.5:32b. Auto-queues overflow. |
| Agent profiles for branches | Hybrid: shared persona, branched activity/stance | Full regeneration, share everything | Consistent identities for fair comparison. Divergent behavioral responses reflect the decision. |
| Comparison data | Neo4j for structure, JSON on disk for metrics | All Neo4j, all filesystem | High-volume time-series is better as flat files. Neo4j for relationship linking. |
| Causal extraction | 3-stage: deterministic event graph → LLM scoring → tree construction | Pure parsing only, full LLM, multi-agent debate | Balances accuracy and cost. Pre-filtering removes ~50% of noise before LLM scoring. |

## Architecture

### New Backend Services
- `backend/app/api/decision_lab.py` — Flask blueprint for Decision Lab API
- `backend/app/services/decision_lab_manager.py` — Orchestrates branch creation, parallel execution, comparison
- `backend/app/services/consequence_extractor.py` — 3-stage causal chain extraction from simulation logs
- `backend/app/services/branch_config_generator.py` — Wraps SimulationConfigGenerator with decision injection

### New Frontend Components
- `frontend/src/views/DecisionLabView.vue` — Main Decision Lab page
- `frontend/src/components/ScenarioBuilder.vue` — Situation + decision branch setup
- `frontend/src/components/BranchRunner.vue` — Parallel simulation monitoring
- `frontend/src/components/ConsequenceTree.vue` — D3 tree visualization
- `frontend/src/components/BranchComparison.vue` — Side-by-side metrics
- `frontend/src/composables/useConsequenceTree.js` — D3 tree layout composable

### Directory Structure (new files)
```
uploads/decision_labs/{lab_id}/
  lab_config.json                 # Lab metadata, branch definitions
  comparison.json                 # Computed comparison metrics
  branches/
    branch_{label}/
      decision_text.txt           # Injected decision text
      config.json                 # Variant simulation config
      profiles_twitter.csv
      reddit_profiles.json
      actions.jsonl
      run_state.json
  consequences/
    event_graph.json              # Stage 1: deterministic event links
    causal_scores.json            # Stage 2: LLM-scored significance
    consequence_tree.json         # Stage 3: final tree structure
```

## Risks & Mitigations
- **VRAM exhaustion with 3 parallel branches**: Mitigate with `OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4` (~40GB). RTX PRO 6000 has 96GB — plenty of headroom.
- **LLM cost of causal extraction**: Pre-filter action logs (remove DO_NOTHING, REFRESH, etc.) to reduce LLM calls by ~50%.
- **Inconsistent branch comparisons**: Use hybrid profile approach (shared persona, branched behavior) for controlled experiments.
- **Large consequence trees (100+ nodes)**: Collapsible tree with 2-3 levels visible by default. Lazy-load deeper nodes.
- **Ontology generation is not refresh-safe**: Make it async (background task) in Phase 1 to prevent data loss.
